notes: Translated from OVAL access_control/includedIn1-3. The originals have no target and requests with no Asset; due2 requires both (IM 2.6.1; workflows §3.2 makes request.target mandatory — see conformance/external/README.md on OVAL's target-less requests). Each scenario targets the asset of the rule it exercises, so the other rule is F on target and the case still isolates the action part.

scenarios.name: play under a permission on use (includedIn1)

expected.why: play includedIn use (profiles/odrl-actions.ttl), so play ⊑ use and ex:policy:1010#use applies; the request names no assignee, but the rule names none either, so no party part arises.

scenarios.name: use under a permission on play (includedIn2)

expected.why: The request is for the broader action: use ⋢ play, so ex:policy:1010#play does not apply (workflows §5.2: never the reverse).

scenarios.name: sell under a permission on use (includedIn3)

expected.why: sell includedIn transfer, not use, so sell ⋢ use and ex:policy:1010#use does not apply.
